description: This file defines the LogWrapper class which implements the LogNode interface. It wraps Android's native Log utility to allow plugging into a logging chain, enabling logs to be sent to multiple targets.

classes.name: LogWrapper
classes.description: A class that wraps Android's Log utility and forwards log messages to a chain of LogNode objects.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the linked list.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode to receive log data after this one.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Logs data using Android's native log mechanism; also forwards the log to the next node in the chain if present.
